title: USD Halo
build_command: docker run --rm -u 1000:1000 -e HOME=/tmp -v "$PWD:/work" -w /work --entrypoint sh louislam/uptime-kuma:2 -c 'npm ci && npm run build'

checks.production_build: passed: TypeScript + Vite; dist/index.html and both dist/fonts WOFF2 files exist; no missing-font warnings
checks.videos: both supplied videos decoded and played, muted, looping and inline
checks.interactions: CTA anchors, desktop navigation, wallet preview dialog, close button and Escape passed
checks.marquees: 22s hero and 30s backers; reduced-motion override verified

fonts.method: document.fonts + Chromium CSS.getPlatformFontsForNode; both desktop and mobile
fonts.http: both WOFF2 URLs return 200 with font/woff2 under required project subpath
fonts.build_copy: dist/fonts binaries match public/fonts SHA-256 hashes

checks.served_directory: dist/ (temporary local HTTP server at required publishing subpath)

notes: Ready for management-session review; not deployed or pushed.
React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS + lucide-react; dependency lockfile included.
Original hero and commerce videos and savings-card image downloaded successfully and included locally.
No wallet provider or destination was supplied. Open Wallet shows an honest preview-availability dialog.
Navigation uses existing section anchors because external destinations were not supplied.
All project writes remained within this directory; no agents or other sessions created.
Repaired missing production font files using unmodified WOFF2 assets from TypeType’s official TT Norms Pro page. Source URLs and hashes recorded in public/fonts/provenance.json.
Regular is mapped to 400 and the foundry’s DemiBold to the specified semibold filename and weight 600. Original font family, font-display: swap, inheritance, layout, copy and assets preserved.
Source /fonts/ URLs are rewritten by Vite to the configured publishing subpath, with local binaries copied into dist/fonts/.
screenshots/live-check.json retains the pre-repair production failure. screenshots/browser-report.json verifies the repaired dist output; no deployment or claim of changed remote production state.
